verdict.rationale: The evidence shows shareable Payment Links (sendable over email or SMS) and a Hosted Payment Page. These are adjacent payment-collection features, not hosted invoices. Nothing in the pack documents automatic reminders. The 'invoices' mentioned in the reconciliation docs are things merchants reconcile against Checkout.com's reports, not customer invoices the merchant issues.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders
